dct_title_s: Maryland Area Rail Commuter (MARC) train lines [Maryland--Baltimore] [2026]
dct_description_sm: Historical dataset of line geometry features representing the location of Maryland Area Rail Commuter (MARC) train rail lines in Baltimore City, as administered by the Maryland Transit Authority (MTA). Heavy Rail - Railroad centerlines for the City's Heavy rail system. Light Rail - Railroad centerlines for the City's Light rail system Subway Rail - Railroad centerlines for the City's subway system. Abandoned Rail - Railroad centerlines that are obviously abandoned as evidenced by vegetation overgrowth. This data was created as a landbase feature as part of the planimetric data.
